catalog.moat_and_risks: Structural technical monopoly: without TSMC there is no iPhone, no Vera Rubin, no AMD chip. The most critical single point of failure in the entire chain, irreplaceable for 10+ years; its risk is geopolitical concentration in Taiwan.
catalog.role: The foundry that manufactures 90%+ of the world's leading-edge chips.
catalog.source: Khipus supply-chain graph snapshot (data/grafo_v0.json, curated catalog) — descriptive text curated by Khipus; figures inside may be approximate
catalog.supplies: 3nm and 2nm logic chip manufacturing plus advanced CoWoS packaging for Nvidia, Apple, AMD and Qualcomm. The N2 node enters volume ramp in 2026, with fabs expanding in Arizona, Japan and Germany.

edge_semantics.note: top_suppliers/top_customers list only FLOW relations (goods, fab, cloud, license, power, ownership, deployment). partner/invest are in `related`. verified=false / confidence=0.3 when the curated text says the link is unverified or only possible.

network_risk_score.explain: Network Risk Score 0-100 (higher = more fragile position in the AI supply chain): country/geo risk + graph centrality + margin + fundamentals + concentration. A heuristic, not a forecast.
network_risk_score.method: catalog formula via hot view V3 card (same formula as the app computeNRS; structural degree = flow relations, distinct pairs, of the current graph generation)
